# Contributing

Bug reports, ideas and pull requests are welcome.

## Report a bug

Open an [issue](https://github.com/Zyniel/dss-plugin-clear-datasets-by-tags/issues/new/choose) with the bug report form. Give the DSS version, the plugin version and, if you can, the `RECAP_JSON` line of the run log: it holds the whole recap. Issues are public: remove the names and data you do not want to share.

Never report a vulnerability in an issue: follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md).

## Change the code

1. Set up the project and run the checks: see [development](../docs/development.md).
2. Read the [architecture](../docs/architecture.md). To add a macro, follow [add a macro](../docs/adding-a-macro.md).
3. With each change: tests, the CHANGELOG, and the docs it touches. The checks of the CI must pass.
4. Commit with your GitHub noreply address, as [development](../docs/development.md#set-up) explains.
5. Open a pull request on `main`. Say what you checked on a real DSS, if anything.
